# Ginza ETHICA (銀座 ETHICA)

> Listed in the MICHELIN Guide Tokyo (Selected) for 3 years in a row. Three minutes from Ginza Station. In a cave-like room, each dish tells part of Earth's 4.6-billion-year story: a journey through time on a plate, by a chef from two-Michelin-star MAZ. For business dinners, there is also a private room inside the kitchen.

- Address: 1-3-3 Ginza, Toa Bldg. 1F, Chuo-ku, Tokyo 104-0061, Japan (東京都中央区銀座1-3-3 東亜ビル 1F)
- Phone: +81-3-6228-7313 (reception 12:00-17:00)
- Hours: Dinner Tue-Fri 17:30-23:00, Sat-Sun 18:00-23:00 (last entry 20:30). Lunch Sat-Sun 11:30-14:30 (last entry 12:30). Closed Mondays.
- Cuisine: Innovative, Peruvian
- Recognition: Listed in the MICHELIN Guide Tokyo (Selected) for 3 years in a row
- Reservations (English and other languages): https://omakaseje.com/z5e4g
- Reservations (Japanese): https://res-reserve.com/ja/restaurants/ethicatokyo

## Courses (per person, tax included, JPY)

- Short Course (ショートコース): 14,800 yen. For guests with plans after dinner, or who want to focus on drinks: five light chapters. A short first taste of the ETHICA journey.
- ETHICA Collection (ETHICA コレクション): 19,800 yen. Our signature course: eight dishes that travel back and forth through Earth's 4.6 billion years. The season's best ingredients are cooked with ají amarillo (a yellow chili from the Andes) and quinoa. The meal ends with a dessert of lucuma, a fruit from the Andes.
- ETHICA Grand Collection (ETHICA グランド・コレクション): 24,800 yen. The Collection's story in nine chapters, with rarer ingredients. For nights when you want a longer, deeper journey.
- Chef's Counter (シェフズ・カウンター): 27,800 yen. A counter inside the kitchen, for only one group a day. Nine chapters based on the Grand Collection, with rarer cuts and ingredients of the day. The chef finishes each dish in front of you.
- Gastronomy Experience (ガストロノミー体験): 29,800 yen. A private room inside the kitchen, for only one group a day. Nine chapters made with rare ingredients and carefully aged foods, just 30 cm from where the chef finishes each plate.
- Birthday & Anniversary Course (誕生日・記念日コース): 25,200 yen. The nine chapters of the Grand Collection, ending with a message plate painted by hand. The last page of a 4.6-billion-year story becomes a memory to share with someone special.
- Vegetarian ETHICA Collection (ベジタリアン ETHICA コレクション): 19,800 yen. The ETHICA story told with vegetarian ingredients, in 8 chapters. We can also prepare vegan or Muslim-friendly meals if you ask.

## Questions and answers

### It's my first visit. Which course should I choose?
We recommend the ETHICA Collection (8 chapters). It tells the full ETHICA story. If you have plans after dinner, try the 5-chapter Short Course.

### How long does the meal take?
About 1.5 hours for the Short Course (5 chapters), about 2.5 hours for the ETHICA Collection (8 chapters), and 2.5–3 hours for the 9-chapter courses.

### Can you help us celebrate an anniversary?
We can make a message plate, painted by hand. Please choose the Birthday & Anniversary Course, or tell us when you book. If you ask, we can also order a Ginza Calon “Everlasting Bouquet” (long-lasting flowers).

### Do you have a private room for business dinners?
Our private room inside the kitchen is for 2–4 guests, one group a day. Please book the Gastronomy Experience (9 chapters).

### Can I enjoy the meal if I don't drink?
We have a non-alcoholic pairing (9,800), with a drink matched to each dish. Please tell us when you book.

### Can you handle allergies and vegetarian diets?
Please tell us about any allergies, including those of others in your group, when you book. We also have the Vegetarian ETHICA Collection. For vegan or Muslim-friendly meals, please tell us when you book.

### Can I book for one?
Yes. You can book the Short Course, ETHICA Collection, Grand Collection, Vegetarian ETHICA Collection and Chef's Counter for one person. The Birthday & Anniversary Course and the Gastronomy Experience (private room) need at least two guests.

### Is there a dress code?
Smart casual, please. Please do not wear tank tops, shorts or beach sandals. Other than that, you do not need to dress up.

### What payment methods do you accept?
We accept credit cards (VISA, Mastercard, JCB, AMEX, Diners), as well as transit IC cards, iD and QUICPay.

### Can I book at the last minute?
Yes. If there are open seats, you can book even at the last minute. Please check the booking page first.

### Can we book the whole restaurant for a large group?
You can book the whole restaurant for up to 20 guests (please ask about standing parties). Please call 03-6228-7313 (12:00–17:00, Japanese only).
